text:
rita: Heads up — scheduling a controlled maintenance in apac-east2 for Sun 00:30-03:30 local. Trigger: intermittent packet stalls traced to NIC microcode plus an older GPU driver combo on 3 racks. Plan: apply NIC microcode, safe reboot, quick GPU driver refresh. Reserved pools not touched.

ben: Estimated shared capacity loss? Any plan for backfill?

rita: Expect ~4-8% transient loss depending on cohort size. We'll prefer serial single-rack cohorts (5-8 nodes) with a canary first. Backfill only intra-region spare capacity; cross-region is last resort.

hao: Canary timeline? metrics to hold on?

rita: Canary rack at 00:45 (5 nodes). Hold for 20m. Automated checks: p95 latency, error rate, retransmit count, GPU temp delta. Manual approval required before next rack.

min: Ops notes — pre-warm model caches 40m before start and pause large batch evals 00:00-05:00. Also add temporary route to apac-west spare pool for tail-sensitive models.

ops-bot: Maintenance ticket created: apac-east2-nic-gpu-6512468012. Link: https://console.internal/maint/6512468012 (automated).

ben: Cost note: pulling 12 GPUs intra-region for 3h ~ ~$700. Cross-region ~ $1.6k. We'll only spend if p95 > +150ms or error +0.3%.

hao: Runbook snippet for oncall (copy):
```bash
# cordon and drain example nodes
kubectl cordon node-ae2-r05{01..05} -n inference
kubectl drain node-ae2-r05{01..05} --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=240 -n inference
# apply microcode and reboot
ssh ops@node-ae2-r050 "sudo /usr/bin/apply-nic-microcode && sudo reboot"
```

min: Add 10m human pause after canary. I'll monitor ml-perf dashboards; Hao you take net counters. Ben you own cost alerts. Please ACK by EOD.

rita: ACK — schedule will go live pending approvals and comms. :white_check_mark:
